column1: # Arad CRM-OS deploy registry — single source of truth (ADR-013).
# Mirrors digital-menu/deploy/apps.tsv. Adding an app: append a row, drop a
# deploy/Dockerfile.<app>, add a Caddy block in deploy/caddy/arad-crm.caddy and
# a service in deploy/compose.yaml. Build/deploy scripts read this file rather
# than hardcoding app names.
# Fields (TAB-separated — do not realign with spaces, the parser splits on \t):
#   app          — short name; matches apps/<app>/ and deploy/Dockerfile.<app>
#   slug         — mvpool slug. All four share the bundled `arad-crm` slug for
#                  the pilot (ADR-013 §4); splitting one out later only changes
#                  this column + its compose service.
#   image        — image name pushed to the pool registry
#   public_host  — production hostname (Caddy + post-deploy smoke check)
#   public_sub   — DNS label under aradap.ir ("-" = no public host)
#   smoke_path   — path expected to return 200 after deploy
#   triggers     — extended regex of repo paths that mark this app changed.
#                  The api row covers worker (one deployable unit, two entrypoints).
# smoke_path notes:
#  - /version.txt is baked into every image's runtime stage post-build.
#  - api uses /v1/health — the existing dedicated liveness route (apps/api/src/modules/health).
#  - worker has no HTTP surface; "-" means the deploy script skips its smoke check.
# Shared-package changes (packages/*, foundation/*) rebuild everything: the
# trigger regexes below are per-app source only, so a shared change must be
# handled by the caller as "all apps changed" (founder doc §16 release checklist).
# app
api
worker
web-seller
ops
# web-admin has no public host — ADR-013 §2 open decision (fold into the vertical
# app vs. its own tenant host). Not deployed in E01; the demo needs neither.
web-admin
